candidates.primary_query: when to use the horn on a motorbike in vietnam
secondary_queries: is honking allowed in hanoi at night
candidates.intent_rationale: Visitors hear constant honking in Vietnamese cities and want to know when the law actually allows the horn and whether night-time honking is fined before riding a rental bike.
candidates.content_angle: Explains the two situations Article 21 of Law 36/2024/QH15 allows (warning of a hazard, signalling an overtake), the ban on continuous honking and on using the horn from 22:00 to 05:00 in residential and hospital areas, the Decree 168/2024 fine, and practical horn etiquette in city traffic.
candidates.working_title: Using the Horn on a Motorbike in Vietnam: What the Law Allows

candidates.primary_query: 베트남 오토바이 몇 명까지 탈 수 있나
secondary_queries: 베트남 오토바이 세 명 타면 벌금
candidates.intent_rationale: Groups and families want to know how many people may ride one motorbike in Vietnam, and whether children count, before renting fewer bikes than people.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 33(1) of Law 36/2024/QH15: one passenger as the rule, at most two only for a sick person going to emergency care, a person under arrest, a child under 12 or an elderly or disabled person; helmet duties for everyone on board; and the Decree 168/2024 fine for carrying two passengers outside those cases.
